caption: The drawing features a dark brown or black background, with a composition dominated by stylized floral motifs and geometric patterns. In the lower right quadrant, brightly colored flowers with yellow, blue, green, and magenta petals and green stems radiate symmetrically from a central point, surrounding a blue four-pointed shape with a white dot in the center. To the upper left, there is an additional yellow flower with a green stem and leaves, as well as a partial view of a brown rectangular area bordered by a thin red outline, inside which green leaves can be seen. Blue dots and white curved lines are also present in this region. Along the right and bottom edges, there are repetitive magenta chevron shapes forming a border. The overall arrangement is geometric and symmetrical, with clearly separated color regions and a strong use of contrast.
title: Stencilled Floor
